subject: Mythology
title: Loki: The Trickster God
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Loki: The Trickster God.

hook.text: Loki was not evil at first. He was the gods' cleverest friend who slowly became their worst enemy.

buildup.text: He was a shapeshifter who could become a salmon, a fly, a mare, or an old woman at will.

discovery.text: His pranks helped the gods at first: he tricked dwarves into forging Mjolnir, Thor's mighty hammer.

twist.text: But he engineered Baldur's death, the most beloved god, and crossed a line that could never be undone.

climax.text: The gods bound him with his own son's entrails beneath a serpent that dripped venom on his face forever.

punchline.text: The cleverest god in Asgard outsmarted everyone except himself.

quiz.question: What act turned the gods permanently against Loki?
options: He stole Thor's hammer and gave it to the giants
He engineered the death of Baldur
He opened the gates of Asgard to the frost giants
